meta.title: 巧用「分屏」! 让你的VLOG更好玩
meta.title_en: Use Split-Screen Smartly to Make Your Vlog More Fun

scenes.title_cn: 开场：这是我准备打喷嚏的画面，没什么…
scenes.title_en: Opening: this is me about to sneeze—not mu…
scenes.context: 分屏是简单好用的画面技巧。
sentences: 非常需要一些简单但能迅速让画面建立确定的技巧，分屏绝对可以拥有姓名。
You need simple tricks that quickly establish a look—split-screen earns a name.
earn a name（拥有姓名）
不管是辅助你的情节来个同频蒙太奇，还是直接做个有趣的转场。
Whether aiding your story with a matching montage or making a fun transition.
matching montage（同频蒙太奇）
都有可能成为你Vlog中让观众眼前一亮的一笔。
It can become the stroke that makes viewers' eyes light up.
eyes light up（眼前一亮）
scenes.speak: You need simple tricks that quickly establish a look—split-screen earns a name. Whether aiding your story with a matching montage or making a fun transition. It can become the stroke that makes viewers' eyes light up.

scenes.title_cn: 电影里的对比分屏：在1916年的俄国…
scenes.title_en: Contrast split-screen in film: in the 1916…
scenes.context: 同构图制造相似，用表演道具制造反差。
sentences: 在1916年的俄国电影《黑桃皇后》中，导演就使用了分屏的手法来对比角色的想象与现实。
In the 1916 film The Queen of Spades, the director split-screen to contrast imagination and reality.
contrast the two（对比两块）
通过构图、场景去营造两块画面的相似性，再通过表演、道具的区别来营造反差。
Build similarity with composition and setting, then contrast with performance and props.
similarity and contrast（相似与反差）
scenes.speak: In the 1916 film The Queen of Spades, the director split-screen to contrast imagination and reality. Build similarity with composition and setting, then contrast with performance and props.

scenes.title_cn: 分屏的变化用法：同样的思路，分屏的场…
scenes.title_en: Split-screen variations: with the same ide…
scenes.context: 同构图不同人物，或分屏合而为一。
sentences: 可以是一男一女，但是构图相同，比如两个人都在赶路。
A man and a woman with the same composition—say, both walking.
same composition（同构图）
一种非常经典的表现双向奔赴的拍摄手法。
A classic way to show two people moving toward each other.
moving toward（双向奔赴）
在角色碰面之后，让分屏顺滑地合而为一。
After the characters meet, let the split-screen smoothly merge.
merge into one（合而为一）
scenes.speak: A man and a woman with the same composition—say, both walking. A classic way to show two people moving toward each other. After the characters meet, let the split-screen smoothly merge.

scenes.title_cn: 多格漫画分屏：另一种Vlog利用法，…
scenes.context: 多格漫画式分屏做开头，两块画面互动。
sentences: 动漫中常见的多格漫画式分屏，用来做Vlog的开头是个不错的选择。
The anime-style multi-panel split-screen is a great vlog opener.
comic panels（多格漫画）
让分屏两面的画面形成一个完整的构图，并且让不同空间的场景发生互动。
Form one complete composition and let different spaces interact.
spaces interact（空间互动）
scenes.speak: The anime-style multi-panel split-screen is a great vlog opener. Form one complete composition and let different spaces interact.

scenes.title_cn: 打电话分屏：我们可以这样，拍一段打电…
scenes.title_en: Phone-call split-screen: we can shoot a ph…
scenes.context: 打电话分屏让两人躺在不同的床上。
sentences: 在打电话的场景玩分屏，在电影里是经常出现的。
Split-screen on phone calls appears constantly in film.
phone-call split（打电话分屏）
这样的手法能让男女角色躺在不同的床上打情骂俏，亲密又不至于越界。
It lets a couple lie in different beds, flirting—intimate without crossing the line.
flirting across screens（隔屏打趣）
scenes.speak: Split-screen on phone calls appears constantly in film. It lets a couple lie in different beds, flirting—intimate without crossing the line.

scenes.title_cn: 进场的细节：如果你想要你的分屏再多一…
scenes.title_en: Entrance details: if you want a little mor…
scenes.context: 用门、窗、拉链等动作框架让分屏自然进场。
sentences: 边开冰箱门也形成分屏，任何一扇门或者窗都可以这样用。
Opening the fridge forms the split—any door or window works.
door and window（门与窗）
利用画面中可能通过动作形成的框架，能让分屏画面自然地进场。
Use frames formed by actions so the split screens enter naturally.
natural entrance（自然进场）
可谓是千变万化。
The possibilities are truly endless.
endless（千变万化）
scenes.speak: Opening the fridge forms the split—any door or window works. Use frames formed by actions so the split screens enter naturally. The possibilities are truly endless.

practice: Match montage, transition, or eye-catching stroke.
Same composition, different reality and imagination.
Two people, same framing, both walking.
Let the split screens merge after they meet.
Doors, windows, zippers frame the split naturally.
pitfalls: Use identical frames with no story.
Change the scene and people, keep the composition.
Form one complete composition across spaces.
分屏两块要形成整体构图。
Let a door, window, or zipper frame it naturally.
Match the split to your story's mood.
shifts: 说分屏只会说 split screen
用 matching montage（同频蒙太奇）、merge into one（合而为一）、comic panels（多格漫画）
用 similarity and contrast（相似与反差）、imagination and reality（想象与现实）
用 same composition（同构图）、natural entrance（自然进场）、frame formed by action（动作框架）
